sloka: समुद्राश्चापि सङ्क्षुब्धाश्चलिताश्चापि पर्वताः ।यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धाः किमेतदिति चाब्रुवन् ।। ७.१६.३१ ॥
transliteration: samudrāścāpi saṅkṣubdhāścalitāścāpi parvatāḥ ।yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhāḥ kimetaditi cābruvan ।। 7.16.31 ॥

translations.english: The oceans became greatly agitated, the mountains were shaken, and Yakshas, Vidyadharas, and Siddhas all exclaimed, "What is this?"
